text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a reply from Fukukitaru-san... I 
wonder if the fortune-telling results came 
in?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"My lucky item is 'vehicles'. A-Alright... 
maybe I'll go ride a train...!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Fufu, today should go well now!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder what else the fortune says? 
Let's see..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? The lucky item is... a "Golden 
Shachihoko"? And vehicles are... an 
UNLUCKY item!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Wh-Wh-Wh-What should I do...! I took the 
wrong one... I-I have to get off!"

text_block_list.name: Train Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"This train is a special express~, so 
there will be no stops until the final 
destination~"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?! Is there really no salvation for 
us~?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...T-That's it! Excuse meee!! Does anyone 
happen to have a Golden Shachihoko~~~!?

Meisho Doto became so fixated on her 
fortune that she ended up skipping 
training...
